full_prompt_en: A square, densely ornamented mixed-media illustration shows an armored rider on a white horse inside a circular woodland scene and an elaborate rectangular border. The outer edge is divided into many tiny boxes containing symbols, miniature pictures, colored circles, and geometric marks, with warm ocher and dark green dominating the frame. Inside it, a broad round opening contains trees and a winding pale path. The rider faces left near the center, seated upright in a blue-gray helmet and red-green tunic, with a quiver and narrow weapons or shafts visible behind the shoulder. One arm extends forward to hold the reins. The white horse stands in profile, its long neck and head crossing the left side of the circle. Small dark and rust-colored markings decorate the flank, while the legs are arranged on the pale ground under a dense tree canopy. Trunks and foliage fill the background in olive, brown, and muted cream, making the mounted pair stand clear against the lighter spaces between them. Around the circle, corner fields of orange, green, and cream are crowded with curling lines, patterned motifs, and fine black ink. The surface is deliberately intricate: stipples, crosshatching, small collage-like fragments, and hand-colored areas meet at sharp seams. No single smooth light source controls the illustration; broad even illumination keeps both the central scene and the miniature border readable. The darkest accents sit in outlines, tree trunks, and border compartments, while the horse supplies the largest light shape. The overall composition is formal and lively, balancing a readable central action with a ring of dense, story-rich ornament.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、装饰密集的混合媒介插画呈现一名披甲骑手骑着白马，位于圆形林间场景及繁复矩形边框内。外缘分成许多小格，装着符号、微型图像、彩色圆点和几何标记，暖赭和深绿主导边框。框内，一道宽阔圆形开口容纳树木和弯曲的浅色道路。骑手在中央附近朝左，直身坐着，戴蓝灰色头盔、穿红绿上衣，肩后可见箭袋与细长武器或杆件。一只手向前伸出握缰。白马以侧身站立，长颈和头伸过圆形左侧。马身带小小深色和铁锈色斑纹，四腿立在浓密树冠下的浅色地面。树干与叶片以橄榄、棕和暗奶油色填满背景，使骑乘的一对从较浅空隙前清楚突出。圆形周围，橙、绿和奶油色角区挤满卷曲线条、图案和细黑墨迹。表面有意繁密：点子、交叉排线、拼贴般小片段和手工上色区域在清楚的接缝处相遇。没有一处平滑光源支配插画；宽泛均匀的照明让中央场景和微型边框都可读。最深色重音位于轮廓、树干和边框格子，白马则提供最大的浅色形状。整体构图正式而活跃，以可读的中央动作平衡一圈密集、仿佛讲故事的纹饰。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media illustration organizes a readable central field within a border of tiny pictorial compartments. Fine black ink outlines, crosshatching, stipple, hand-colored patches, and collage-like seams give every surface a dense tactile pattern. Ocher, olive, rust, cream, blue-gray, and charcoal repeat across different scales, linking the large central form to miniature peripheral marks. Circular and rectangular structures interlock; corner details stay busy while a lighter focal shape provides immediate entry. Light is broadly even, because tonal separation comes from outline density and color blocks more than modeled shadow. Small symbols and repeated geometric accents animate the margins without breaking the overall symmetry. The overall effect is archival and exuberant, with meticulous craft and layered ornament carrying the style.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介插画把可读的中央区域放在由微型图像格子构成的边框内。细黑墨线、交叉排线、点纹、手工上色色斑和拼贴般接缝使每处表面都有密集可触的纹样。赭黄、橄榄绿、铁锈色、奶油色、蓝灰与炭色在不同尺度上重复，把大的中央形体与外围微小笔迹连接起来。圆形和矩形结构互相嵌合；角落细节繁忙，较浅的焦点形状则让视线立即进入。光宽泛均匀，因为明暗分离更多来自轮廓密度和色块，而非塑形阴影。小符号和重复几何重音让边缘活跃，却不打破整体对称。整体效果带档案感而热烈，细致手工与层叠装饰承担画风。
theme_en: An armored rider on a white horse inside an ornate illustrated border
theme_zh: 一名骑白马的披甲人物位于华丽插画边框中
name: Tony Fitzpatrick
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
